sources.title: Salience-27B-R4 API & Inference Endpoint | FriendliAI
sources.snippet: Salience 27B is a 27-billion-parameter dense vision-language model built for hard, practical engineering work: writing and debugging real code, repo-scale edits, multi-step terminal agency, and quantitative reasoning — with native vision and a 262K-token context window (extendable to 1M via YaRN).
